data.body:
Landed as Gerrit change 1689, merged to main as 710976dd2f (LLM-Review +1, Verified +1). Removed all three public entry points: the CLI verb 'rebar review' (intercept + _review handler), the library rebar.llm.review_ticket wrapper + its __all__/re-export rows, and the MCP review_ticket tool. The ENGINE _review_ticket_impl STAYS with its two surviving internal consumers (review_workflows.py, eval_solver.py); review_result.schema.json also stays, with its synthetic OUTPUT_SCHEMAS wiring key RE-POINTED from 'review_ticket' to 'review_code' (the surviving producer) so the every-schema-file-is-wired guard still sees it. Generated docs (cli-reference, mcp-reference) were regenerated via their scripts, never hand-edited; server.json's mirrored REBAR_MCP_ALLOW_LLM description was resynced. 41 files, +193/-722. Full suite 12,592 passed / 0 failed.

REGISTRY + TOMBSTONE TREATMENT: the three _scheduled rows (cli/lib/mcp) were DELETED from rebar._deprecations and the pass recorded in that module's historical-record NOTE, matching DE7 (7e29166aec) and the ticket-5899 sibling pass. NO tombstone row was added, and that is deliberate precedent, not an omission: _TOMBSTONE_KINDS is env/cfg/file only, the tombstone registry postdates DE7, and the precedent removals of CLI/library/MCP surfaces (list-epics, --no-sync, rebar.list_epics(), the list_epics MCP tool) added none. A removed verb/function/tool simply stops existing.
